meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 装上后，当你在不同AI提供商之间切换时，Claude能读取旧提供商的记忆文件，提炼出重要信息（如身份指令、用户偏好），并写入新提供商的记忆系统中，然后重启群组。
howto.when: 当你对Claude说“迁移记忆”或“记忆丢失”等关键词，或者你手动切换了群组的AI提供商（如从Claude切换到Codex）时触发。

say.text: 迁移记忆，我从Claude切换到了Codex。
say.note: Claude会读取旧记忆并写入新系统。

say.text: 帮我检查一下记忆迁移是否成功。
say.note: Claude会验证目标文件是否已正确写入。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you switch between different AI providers, Claude reads the old provider's memory files, distills important information (like identity instructions, user preferences), writes it into the new provider's memory system, and restarts the group.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "migrate memory" or "memory lost", or when you manually switch the group's AI provider (e.g., from Claude to Codex).

say_en.text: Migrate memory, I switched from Claude to Codex.
say_en.note: Claude reads old memory and writes to new system.

say_en.text: Check if the memory migration was successful.
say_en.note: Claude verifies the target file landed correctly.
